# Independent baseline type-chart retest

Exact target: `5c93802893a15bb9716f9143fe20f2cfc5a7c345`, clean detached `retest-5c93802`. Reference: compiled Showdown Champions mod `9b136a8c8cdb860a8ab96fa063f906604e352547`. Date: 2026-10-21 UTC. Scoped verdict: baseline chart repair passes; no surviving baseline multiplier defect found.

## Results

- Original Weezing U-turn into Venusaur, Defense 95, stage zero, no weather/item/critical, both orientations: all 16 rolls match reference 31–37. Old engine still gives 62–74. Full vectors retained.
- 5,832 ordered inputs: 324 single-type and 5,508 ordered dual-type cases. Independently decode the reference's defensive `damageTaken` values (0=neutral, 1=weakness, 2=resistance, 3=immunity) and multiply their factors. Zero mismatches against observed engine factors or shared helper. This is 3,078 distinct unordered matchups, with reverse-order checks; not 5,832 distinct mechanics. Includes 280 ordered immunity inputs.
- The generated HTML bundle's chart independently matches all 5,832 inputs. Historical shared data produces 163 disagreements; historical engine produces 35. The four historical Ice errors are confined to shared data: old engine Ice was correct. Bug-to-Poison was wrong in both.
- Eleven supplied reference tests pass, including eight unique-anchor mutation controls: five repaired cells, adding instead of multiplying factors, ignoring the second type and removing immunity. Mutation failures are numerical disagreements, not harness crashes. Two additional test-file wrappers pass, each containing five internal checks (damage pipeline and report). Do not sum nested counts as independent coverage.
- Battle-audit contract command passes. Report regeneration changes only its generated timestamp; regenerated artifact retained and checkout restored clean.

## Consumers and expected answers

`poke-sim/data.js:5409` is now the canonical chart; `:5433` shared effectiveness helper uses it. `engine.js:2684` reads the same chart. The engine's old private copy is removed. `tools/generate-type-multiplier-audit.mjs:40` reads the runtime chart rather than maintaining another copy; `:168` applies it. `ui.js:22186` consumes the canonical chart. Generated HTML contains the corrected chart and runtime consumer. Source search found no additional live chart literal outside data and its generated bundle; preserved historical report sources deliberately retain old bytes.

`tests/damage_pipeline_tests.js` no longer copies the faulty engine chart into expected calculations. It uses the external Champions Dex, including immunity and the explicit Freeze-Dry Water exception. The focused reference matrix obtains expected factors from external Dex, not candidate chart. Our audit additionally derives factors directly from pinned reference `damageTaken` data. These share the same upstream source, not separate authoritative evidence.

The report tests mainly verify strings and source wiring. Regeneration proves reproducibility, not independent validation of every species/move summary. The report and UI are consumers of the now-tested chart, not additional truth oracles. UI rendering was not visually retested.

## Limits and next gate

This is baseline direct-damage typing with synthetic neutral setup. Freeze-Dry, Flying Press, ability immunity, grounding, Tera, move-type changes, item exceptions and full-turn targeting are not exhaustively covered by multiplying baseline factors. No current-client or official regulation proof; no singles execution or broader competitive-policy certification. Eviolite negative-stage rounding remains separately open. No full stress/golden suite, hosted CI, tracker certification or deployed-site checks were repeated.

Commands: locked dependency install with scripts disabled; `node --test tests/type_effectiveness_reference_tests.mjs tests/type_multiplier_audit_tests.js tests/damage_pipeline_tests.js`; `npm --prefix poke-sim run test:battle-audit:contract`; `node poke-sim/tools/generate-type-multiplier-audit.mjs`; independent `node type-5c93802-independent.mjs`. Reference/dependency paths supplied through CHAMPIONS_REFERENCE_SIM and NODE_PATH. No active working-tree reads/changes, production, settings, merge or preview action.

Artifacts: `type-5c93802-independent.mjs`, `type-5c93802-independent.log`, `type-5c93802-tests.log`, `type-5c93802-contract.log`, `type-5c93802-evidence/independent.json`, and regenerated report. Receipt includes exact target, clean status and hashes.
